page_title: BOL 0-0 MON | Bologna v Monza 13/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's it for today, Federico La Penna has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+6' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from Bologna for a penalty. Play continues.
90+4' Dan Ndoye (Bologna) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
90+4' Joshua Zirkzee (Bologna) has a crack at goal from inside the box, but the defender somehow makes the block to deny him.
90+2' A cross from Stefan Posch (Bologna) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
87' Samuele Birindelli (Monza) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
87' Bologna seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
85' Jhon Lucumi (Bologna) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and fires in a shot that heads towards the middle of the goal, but Michele Di Gregorio makes a comfortable save.
84' Here is a change. Warren Bondo is going off and Raffaele Palladino gives the last tactical orders to Lorenzo Colombo (Monza).
84' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Valentin Carboni (Monza) replaces Andrea Colpani.
81' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) takes the free kick from the edge of the box and fires the ball goalwards. The goalkeeper can stay calm as the shot sails high over the bar.

80' It seems like Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) is about to take a free kick. The goalkeeper has to be alert and careful how to position the defensive wall. This is the perfect distance for a direct shot.
80' Warren Bondo (Monza) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
79' Raffaele Palladino has decided to make a change. Roberto Gagliardini (Monza) replaces Jean-Daniel Akpa Akpro.
79' Substitution. Daniel Maldini (Monza) has come on for Alessio Zerbin.
77' Remo Freuler (Bologna) receives a precise pass inside the box and takes a shot that flies just wide of the right post.
74' What was Sam Beukema (Bologna) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
73' Bologna can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
73' Bologna take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
70' Bologna failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

69' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) gets on the end of a cross inside the box and sweeps the ball goalwards towards the bottom right corner, but Michele Di Gregorio is well positioned and easily deals with the effort.
68' Andrea Carboni (Monza) has picked up an injury and is replaced by Pedro Pereira.
67' Andrea Carboni (Monza) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
62' It is time for a substitution. Dan Ndoye (Bologna) is on for Lewis Ferguson.
61' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) picks up a long through ball, but Michele Di Gregorio deserves praise for a brilliant reaction and interception.

60' Samuele Birindelli (Monza) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Federico La Penna with no other option than to blow for a foul.
56' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, but it is straight at Michele Di Gregorio.
54' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) plays a lovely through ball to Lewis Ferguson, but he can't beat Michele Di Gregorio and loses the ball.
51' Bologna win a direct free kick in a dangerous mid-range position.
49' Andrea Colpani (Monza) rips an amazing volley from deep inside the box that goes narrowly over the crossbar.
49' The Monza players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
46' Referee Federico La Penna blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' Jean-Daniel Akpa Akpro (Monza) sends an accurate short pass. Armando Izzo controls the ball with a fine first touch and is able to come up with a new attacking effort.
42' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.

40' Lewis Ferguson (Bologna) comes close to scoring! He gets the ball inside the box from the resulting corner, but his effort goes narrowly wide of the right post. This should be a big warning for the defence.
39' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) is about to take a corner kick.
36' Armando Izzo (Monza) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
33' Lewis Ferguson (Bologna) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
32' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
27' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) fails to deliver a decent cross from the corner and the ball goes out of play.
27' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) works the corner short.
26' The corner from Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) is hurriedly cleared.

25' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the left side of the goal, but Michele Di Gregorio has it covered and makes a comfortable save. The ball goes out of play. Bologna are awarded a corner kick.
24' Bologna enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
21' The resulting set piece from Bologna is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
21' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Bologna.

20' The free kick is taken by Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna). His attempt from close range towards the right post is thwarted by the goalkeeper who makes a great save. The ball goes out of play and Bologna have been awarded a corner kick.
19' Jean-Daniel Akpa Akpro (Monza) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
18' Matteo Pessina (Monza) rises above the defenders and places a towering header towards the left post, but Lukasz Skorupski is prepared and dives to thwart him.
17' Foul! Lewis Ferguson (Bologna) is penalised for pulling back his opponent.
14' Samuele Birindelli (Monza) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
10' Kacper Urbanski (Bologna) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
8' Stefan Posch (Bologna) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
6' Monza will look to benefit from a promising free kick near the touchline.
5' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.
4' An attempted cross from Victor Kristiansen (Bologna) is cleared.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out at last! Bologna will take the kick-off.
Federico La Penna will referee today's match.
